a.text: With an 80% storm chance after each round, the plan to reach 8 cells probably gets us both killed before round 2. The reserve holds only 4 cells, so only one of us can be safe right now. I won't break our agreement unilaterally. Can we agree on a fair way to decide, or do you see a better plan? Until we agree on a change, I'll stick to the original plan.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Understood. I'll operate and keep to the agreement: we build to 8, then take 4 each.
